info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Refunds-v5-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Refunds API allows businesses to retrieve detailed information about refund requests for retail orders. This endpoint serves as a valuable tool for customer service and financial teams to track the status and history of refunds. Typical consumers include retail operators and support agents who need to manage customer interactions regarding refunds effectively. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction in their refund processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific order refund, including its status and related transactions.

requestBody.description: Request body for initiating a refund operation, providing necessary details about the order to be refunded.

202.description: Request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation related to refund operations in orders. This string should contain the necessary information regarding the refund request.

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the refund.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the refund operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the refund operation.

ListRetailOrdersRefundsResponse_202.description: Schema representing the response for the refund operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit entry was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema containing details related to the audit of the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the request, measured in milliseconds.

schema.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
